lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2031. A courtyard, four low buildings, eighty people and a lawn with test units running a pattern across it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is the room. Five companies pooling five models into one, and a vote on whether the weights get published. Everything I have chased for four days starts in a meeting room at the end of that path.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: It always does. Nobody has ever built one of these in a fortress.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is a woman at the far bench with amber goggles pushed up on her head, arguing with nobody, and a man in a good suit on the steps who has already noticed you.
